How do I start a return or an exchange?
We currently do not offer exchanges, but you can return unsuitable items for a full refund. To start a return, please follow these steps:
Create your return online
Visit https://montirex.loopreturns.com/#/ and enter your order number along with your postcode or the email address used to place the order. Click 'Get Started,' select the item(s) you wish to return, provide the reason for returning, and follow the instructions. Once your return is logged, you will receive an email with further instructions and a free returns barcode label.
Pack your return
Place the items you wish to return in secure packaging. You can reuse the polybag your items arrived in. Ensure the package is securely sealed.
Ship your return
UK Customers: Take the QR code provided to a nearby drop-off location to scan and return the parcel.
International Customers: Print the PDF label provided, attach it firmly to the parcel (covering any pre-existing labels), and take it to your local drop-off location.
Return confirmation and refund
Once your parcel is received and inspected by our quality assurance team, your refund will be processed. The entire process, from sending the items to receiving the refund, can take up to 14 days.
Let me know if you need further clarification!
